pamphlet_excerpts: Plumbing Systems Carry: Plumbing systems carry water into and out of a home through a system of pipes.
Health Safety People: For the health and safety of the people wholive there, the water entering the home through the water-supplysystem must be pure and clean.
Wastewater Come Contact: Wastewater should never come into contact with the water thatthe family uses for drinking, bathing, or washing clothes anddishes.
Main Reason Essential: This is the main reason that it is essential that your family’s plumbing system be properly installed and regularlychecked to make sure it is in good.
step_by_step_procedure: Plumbing Regulations: Plumbing regulations have been developed to help make surethat plumbing is installed and maintained correctly.
Theseregulations Commonly: Theseregulations, commonly called plumbing codes, are important inpreventing the water-supply system from becoming contaminated.
National Plumbing Codes: National plumbing codes exist that give specific regulations for all plumbingoperations.
Communities Adopted: Many communities have adopted these regulationsor amended them to fit their local needs.

pamphlet_excerpts: Air Vents Importantpart: The air vents are an importantpart of waste disposal, which is why the drainage system isoften called the drain-waste-vent (DWV) system.
Drain Andvent Pipes: The drain andvent pipes are tied together, or share pipes, and use the sametypes of pipe.
Illustration Showing: As you can see in the illustration showing the drainageand supply system, the main vent is an extension of the soilpipe.
Without Air Vents: Without air vents, the plumbing system would becomeair-bound, like a small-necked bottle filled with water and then.
step_by_step_procedure: Plumbing System House: The plumbing system of a house relies on two basic things: pressure and gravity.
Feelthe Water Pressure: When you turn on a faucet, you can feelthe water pressure, weak or strong.
Pressure Comes Pump: The pressure comes from a pump (if the water comes from a well) or from gravity (if the water comes from a water tower or reservoir).
Flush Toilet Pull: When you flush a toilet or pull the plug from a bathtub, gravity pulls the wasteand water down and away from the house.

Tools Plumbing Your family: Many of the tools used in plumbing will be found in your family tool chest.
step_by_step_procedure: Course Handle Toolscarefully: As a Scout, you will, of course, handle toolscarefully, especially borrowed ones.

pamphlet_excerpts: Pipes Fittings Different: Pipes and fittings are made of many different materials.
Homesbuilt Built Cast-iron: Homesbuilt before the 1950s were built with cast-iron and galvanizedsteel pipes.
Instance Kindof Plastic: For instance, a kindof plastic pipe called PVC used to be installed for hot- andcold-water supply, but the hot water made the pipe loseits strength.
Reason PVC Pipe: For this reason, PVC pipe isno longer recommended for use in the indoor water system.
step_by_step_procedure: Outdated Product Galvanized: Another outdated product is the galvanized steel pipe.
Galvanized-steel Pipes: Galvanized-steel pipes are strong at first, but corrode andleak after about 50 years.
Days Steel Pipes: These days, steel pipes are usedmostly for gas installation, not for water.
Join Pipesmade: You can join pipesmade of differentmaterials if youfollow your localcode and use theproper fittings.

requirements.lead_text: Do FOUR of the following, each under the supervision of a knowledgeable adult:
requirements.req_text: Do FOUR of the following, each under the supervision of a knowledgeable adult: (a) Visit the plumbing section of a hardware store or home center and identify: (1) PVC pipe and fittings (2) CPVC pipe and fittings (3) PEX pipe and fittings (4) Copper pipe and fittings (5) Steel pipe and fittings (6) Specialty plumbing tools (b) Cut, clean (deburr), PVC or CPVC pipe; solvent weld at least three connections to include a coupling, tee, and elbow. (c) Cut PEX pipe; make at least one connection using either a quick-connect fitting or a crimp fitting (using specialized tools). (d) Solder a copper connection using a gas torch. (e) Replace a kitchen or lavatory faucet. (f) Remove, clean or replace, and reinstall a sink or lavatory drain trap. (g) Properly apply pipe thread tape to a pipe or a plumbing connector.

Covers Installationsand: It covers installationsand repairs in homes, commercial properties, and factories.
Plumbing Pipelines Water: Plumbing pipelines are used for water supply, waste drainage, natural-gas heating, and many other purposes.
Major Interest Plumbing: As a Scout, your major interest in plumbing probably willbe in the field of home repairs.
step_by_step_procedure: Faucet Leaks Pipe: If a faucet leaks, a pipe freezes, or a plumbing fixture does not operate properly, you will wantto know how to evaluate the problem.
Then Todecide Proper: Then you will be able todecide on the proper steps to take to fix the problem, or determine that the job requires a professional plumber.
Discover Plumbing Problem: When you discover a plumbing problem, you canoften take care of basic plumbing needs, but rememberthat a plumber is like a doctor.
Serious Trouble Orproblems: For serious trouble orproblems beyond your ability, you should get help from a trained specialist.
